newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daesung Ind shares down on merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Daesung Ind shares down on merger plan.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Daesung Industrial Co fell 1,100 won to 48,800 in Monday afternoon trading after the company announced a plan to absorb its affiliate Daesung Resources Co, brokers said.
Daesung Resources shares fell 100 at 84,600 won.
"Investors were somewhat doubt if the merger will benefit Daesung Industrial's future earnings," said a Daishin Securities broker.
Daesung Industrial said earlier on Monday every 10 shares of Daesung Resources would be exchanged for 16.95 shares of Daesung Industrial.
Daesung Industrial sells oil products, while Daesung Resources produces limestone for industrial use.
